findings.defect: Thin shoulder lip and truncated thread-end wedges
findings.evidence: Front and iso show a fine lip around the shoulder; numeric report locates thin walls at the shoulder and thread ends.
findings.repair: Thicken shoulder downward while retaining orange seat datum; taper thread ends and runout to self-supporting slopes.

observation: The hollow sightline is clear and threads render intact. The shoulder has a visibly knife-thin outer lip, consistent with the wall and overhang failures.
